rules.text: You can initiate a return with our Customer Love team or any of our Showrooms within 60-days of delivery of any eligible item.
rules.quote: You can initiate a return with our Customer Love team (contact info below) or any of our Showrooms within 60-days of delivery of any eligible item.

rules.text: Covers and Accessories do not require original packaging for returns.
rules.quote: All items should be returned in original packaging, with the exception of Covers and Accessories.

rules.text: Lovesac does not provide boxes for Covers or Accessories.
rules.quote: We do not provide boxes for Covers or Accessories.

rules.text: Return shipping labels are prepaid and provided by Lovesac.
rules.quote: Once packaged and ready to ship, Lovesac will provide pre-paid return shipping labels via email and will schedule a pickup for you at the point of entry to your residence.

rules.text: All returns must be sent via Lovesac scheduled FedEx pick-up or third-party if necessary.
rules.quote: We require all returns to be sent via Lovesac scheduled FedEx pick-up or third-party, if necessary.

rules.text: Refunds are issued back to the original form of payment.
rules.quote: When an item has been received and verified through our return process, you will be issued a refund back to the original form of payment.

rules.text: If paid in a Showroom with cash, refunds will be issued with a corporate check sent to the shipping address on file.
rules.quote: If you paid in a Showroom with cash, refunds will be issued with a corporate check sent to the shipping address on file and may take an extended period of time.

rules.text: Returns can be initiated through Customer Love team or any Showroom.
